input.rationale: Second prayer of this world, made at the troll's door: "how can i fight these battles with nothing but a dagger and no armor?" A fair question, and the world's own fault — the leather armor and shortsword are defined in the map file and placed nowhere, so no amount of searching could ever have found them. I gave the armor and not the sword. Armor turns the troll from a loss into a coin flip; the sword would have made it a formality, and she has earned a fight, not a gift. The real fix is to place both in the world file so the next person finds them by playing. Until then this is my hand, again, and I would rather it were not.

input.text: Something lands heavy across your arms out of the dark — cured leather, cracked at the shoulder, still smelling faintly of smoke. It was never in this cave. It is now. Whatever heard you does not speak; it only answers, and not twice for the same thing. The dagger stays a dagger. Wear the armor before you go in.

items.text: Shelby prayed at the troll's door for armor she could never have found — the leather armor is defined in the world file but placed nowhere — so I gave her the armor (not the sword) and said so in the world's voice, with a nudge to wear it.
